display.purpose: Brand name and prominent airport sign lettering; Archivo uses its condensed variable width.

headline.purpose: Main panel and page headings in heavy, condensed Archivo.

title.purpose: Smaller section headings, especially on narrow screens.

body.purpose: Normal-width copy, form values, route details, and status.

label.purpose: Field names, table context, and compact status labels.

shadows.name: sign-frame
shadows.purpose: Double inset border that gives airport signs their framed wayfinding edge.

shadows.name: primary-action-frame
shadows.purpose: Inset ink frame around the yellow search action.

shadows.name: selected-segment
shadows.purpose: Shallow separation for the selected paper segment only.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Direct, quick ease for disclosure, selection, progress, and route-detail transitions.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Color and border feedback on buttons, fields, and choices.

motion.name: result-detail
motion.purpose: Small vertical reveal when a flight row is expanded.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Near-instant transitions and a single animation iteration when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Search Button
components.description: Full-width yellow action with a structural inset frame.
components.css: .ds-btn-go { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; padding: 18px 22px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--r-sign); background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px var(--yellow), inset 0 0 0 6px var(--ink); font-family: var(--font); font-stretch: 72%; font-weight: 850; font-size: 1.75rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-go:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--yellow-2); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px var(--yellow-2), inset 0 0 0 6px var(--ink); } .ds-btn-go:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-go:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-go:disabled { cursor: progress; }

components.name: Booking Link
components.description: Compact blue link that continues to the external flight provider.
components.css: .ds-booking { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: var(--r-ctl); background: var(--blue); color: var(--on-blue); font-family: var(--font); font-weight: 650; font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-booking:hover { background: var(--blue-3); } .ds-booking:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Airport Input
components.description: White, borderless location field inset into an airport sign.
components.html: <input class="ds-sign-input" type="text" placeholder="Stad of luchthaven" aria-label="Bestemming">
components.css: .ds-sign-input { width: 100%; border: 0; border-radius: var(--r-ctl); background: var(--page); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font); font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; padding: 12px 14px; } .ds-sign-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3); font-weight: 450; } .ds-sign-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Paper Field
components.description: White date or select control with a thin rule and visible field states.
components.css: .ds-control { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--r-ctl); background: var(--page); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 550; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-control:hover { border-color: var(--ink-3); } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--blue); } .ds-control[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--red); }

components.name: Airport Sign
components.description: Blue location panel with a double inset white frame.
components.css: .ds-sign { min-width: 0; padding: 18px 18px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--r-sign); background: var(--blue); color: var(--on-blue); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px var(--blue), inset 0 0 0 6px var(--on-blue); font-family: var(--font); } .ds-sign strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 12px; font-stretch: 72%; font-weight: 850; font-size: 1.875rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-sign p { margin: 0; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: var(--r-ctl); background: var(--page); color: var(--ink); font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-sign small { display: block; margin-top: 10px; color: var(--on-blue-2); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-sign:focus-within { --focus: var(--yellow); }

components.name: Paper Page
components.description: Flat, bordered white page for dates and trip options.
components.css: .ds-page { display: grid; gap: 16px; min-width: 0; padding: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--r-sign); background: var(--page); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font); } .ds-page > strong { font-stretch: 72%; font-weight: 850; font-size: 1.625rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-page label { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-page-input { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: var(--r-ctl); background: var(--page); color: var(--ink); font: inherit; } .ds-page-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Segmented Choice
components.description: Compact radio choices with a white selected segment.
components.css: .ds-segment { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; border-radius: var(--r-ctl); background: var(--rule-2); font-family: var(--font); } .ds-segment label { position: relative; display: block; } .ds-segment input { position: absolute; inset: 0; margin: 0; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segment span { display: block; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-segment label:hover span { color: var(--ink); } .ds-segment input:checked + span { background: var(--page); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20, 26, 36, 0.16); } .ds-segment input:focus-visible + span { outline: 3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-segment input:disabled + span { color: var(--ink-3); opacity: 0.55; }

components.name: Route Filter Chip
components.description: Ink-filled chip that names and clears an active route filter.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 10px 7px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--r-ctl); background: var(--ink); color: var(--page); font-family: var(--font); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #2A3342; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Best Price Cell
components.description: Yellow matrix cell that identifies the cheapest route and toggles its result filter.
components.css: .ds-price-cell { position: relative; width: 100%; min-width: 6.5rem; min-height: 60px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 10px 14px 14px; border: 0; background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font); font-size: 1.1875rem; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s, color 0.3s; } .ds-price-cell[aria-pressed="true"] { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--ink); } .ds-price-cell:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Flight Result Row
components.description: Expandable white result row with a duration-scaled route line and a visible fare.
components.html: • Vertrek · Aankomst · Reisduur
components.css: .ds-flight { background: var(--page); } .ds-flight + .ds-flight { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule-2); } .ds-flight-main { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.75rem minmax(12rem, 1.3fr) minmax(9rem, 1fr) minmax(6.5rem, 0.7fr) minmax(5.5rem, auto); align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 14px 16px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--ink); text-align: left; font-family: var(--font); transition: background 0.15s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-flight-main:hover, .ds-flight-main[aria-expanded="true"] { background: var(--page-hover); } .ds-flight-main:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-rank { color: var(--ink-3); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-route { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.6rem minmax(3rem, 1fr) 2.6rem; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-stretch: 78%; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 800; } .ds-leg { position: relative; height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: linear-gradient(var(--rule), var(--rule)) center / 100% 2px no-repeat; } .ds-leg b { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 64%; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--blue); } .ds-leg em { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 35%; width: 10px; height: 10px; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); border: 2.5px solid var(--blue); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--page); } .ds-flight-detail { padding: 4px 16px 18px calc(1.75rem + 32px); background: var(--page-hover); font-size: 0.9375rem; }

narrative.overview:
The interface reads like a printed route guide: a yellow wordmark and cover stripe opens onto blue wayfinding signs, dark panels fields, and a live fare atlas on a deeper ground. The visual hierarchy follows the travel path from location choices to dates, route prices, and flight details.

The system is direct and information-dense without looking like an online travel agency. Flat color, clear rules, tabular figures, and a single Archivo family keep the live search readable as it fills in.
keyCharacteristics: Yellow cover and search action; blue wayfinding surfaces.
Dark panels and tables on a deeper ground.
Condensed Archivo for sign lettering and route codes; tabular figures for comparison.
Flat surfaces, thin rules, and structural inset frames.

rules.name: The Route Sign Rule
rules.body: Keep yellow for the wordmark and cover stripe, the main search action, the best fare, and selected dates, always with On-Yellow Ink on top. Use blue for airport wayfinding and price-table headings; keep the rest of the data on dark panels.

rules.name: The Condense-for-Wayfinding Rule
rules.body: Use Archivo's condensed width for prominent signs and airport codes; keep explanatory copy at normal width.

rules.name: The Flat Print Rule
rules.body: Build depth with tone steps, rules, and inset frames. Do not add ambient card shadows, gradients, or glow; only true overlays (the date picker) cast a shadow.

rules.name: One Dark Theme
rules.body: The product has a single dark theme; do not add a light mode or theme switch.

dos: Do reserve route yellow for the cover band, main search action, and best-price emphasis.
Do use blue sign surfaces for airport wayfinding and price-table headings, with the inset white sign frame.
Do keep price data on dark panels over the deeper ground, using thin rules to organize it.
Do use tabular figures and duration-proportional route lines to support comparison.
Do expand a flight row only after activation, so keyboard focus does not move the results list.
donts: Don't add ambient card shadows, gradients, glow, or glass effects.
Don't use the yellow accent as a broad fill for ordinary fields or long result rows.
Don't expand result details merely because a row receives keyboard focus.
Don't remove a toggled-off airport from its sign list; show its disabled state in place.
